timeline.summary: BC Asia Investments acquired control and became co-promoter of Manappuram Finance on April 21, 2026 following the preferential issue and open offer.
Manappuram Finance reported nil equity shares tendered by public shareholders in the open offer escrow account as of April 20, 2026.
Post-offer advertisement confirmed nil shares were tendered in the open offer by BC Asia Investments, leaving the acquirer with a 9.89% stake.
SEBI issued an administrative warning letter to Chairman and Managing Director V.P. Nandakumar on April 24, 2026, regarding a historical 2018 share pledge disclosure delay.
Manappuram Finance reported Q4FY26 standalone revenue of ₹2,157.54 Cr and PAT of ₹375.52 Cr, declaring an interim dividend of ₹0.50 per share.
Manappuram Finance reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹2,613.83 Cr and PAT of ₹404.79 Cr, declaring an interim dividend of ₹0.50 per share.
Manappuram Finance Limited uploaded the audio recording of its Q4 FY2026 results conference call on May 4, 2026, at www.manappuram.com.
Manappuram Q1FY27 earnings call: consolidated PAT ₹585 Cr (+47% YoY), gold loan AUM ₹57,006 Cr (82% of book), guides 25-30% gold loan growth and 500 branch openings in FY27.
